name: rust-bundled-library
goal: Pinned Rust tools load bundled LLVM on clean macOS without host-owned symlinks; native and Wasm builds retain the pinned compiler and existing budgets.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: PR6 macOS artifact 7c9ad7cf fails snapshot setup: Rust linker and strip tools cannot load bundled libLLVM. Local target-lib symlink masks it. Isolated copies reproduce identical dyld failure.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test that faithfully reproduces the defect; record proof.
steps.evidence: Frozen test/pinned-toolchain-runtime.test.ts fails on unchanged launcher: rust-lld exits by signal because bundled LLVM is outside its rpath. Fixture copies only distributed files; host installation is unchanged.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Put the selected toolchain library directory in the child loader environment, reusing the selected bin directory. Run actual isolated linker and strip binaries in the normal test suite; retain compiler pin and budgets.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Child tools receive the pinned library directory and reuse one bin lookup. Added an own-unit recorded selection scenario; no host writes or budget edits.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Final frozen V2 tests: original launcher 2 failed/7 passed; repaired launcher 9 passed. The corrected Wasm-flavor fixture is identical across those two runs.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Original-source mutation fails real isolated linker loading; restored source passes. Both frozen test hashes and phase logs are recorded in rust-bundled-library-isolated-red-green-v2.json.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and keep pending while proof fails.
